ASHBOUND 1.0.0

Three.js 0.186.1, including OrbitControls: MIT, see three.LICENSE.txt.
InkJS 2.4.0: MIT, see inkjs.LICENSE.txt.
Lucide 1.49.0: ISC, see lucide.LICENSE.txt and the upstream package notices.
Bundled with esbuild 0.28.2. No runtime CDN requests.

New geometry, UI code and ASHBOUND story are HALVETH contributions under the
repository's existing HALVETH PIRL 2.0 terms. Public source availability does
not change those terms into an unrestricted open-source licence.
The standalone chronicle uses original ASHBOUND places and residents. Optional
archive guest profiles remain separately identified; any third-party names and
characters retain their respective owners' rights. This project is not an
official game, endorsement, engine replacement or redistribution of game assets.
No textures, music, models, book text or dialogue from other games are included.
The first-person landscape additionally uses Poly Haven CC0 models and PBR
surfaces. Exact upstream URLs, license and hashes are in play/assets/manifest.json.
